phone.notes: Fixed all Cast options: enabled LAN HTTP cleartext access in network_security_config so CineGhor TV (port 8998) and Chromecast/Google TV (8008/8009) connect without cleartext errors; added NetworkInterface-based LAN subnet scanning for Auto-Scan & Chromecast discovery; serialized NSD discovery queue with multicast lock; fixed CastV2 protobuf framing, PING/PONG heartbeat, CC1AD845 transport matching, and HLS/MKV MIME types; added POST /cast JSON support for large multi-episode series + gateway link resolution from player & movie details.

tv.notes: Updated TV Cast Receiver (TvCastServer) to accept both POST /cast JSON payloads (supporting full multi-episode series, resume episode, and resume position) and legacy GET /cast requests cleanly with socket timeouts and explicit Content-Length headers. Updated player Cast button to display the TV Cast Receiver IP and port instead of an unsupported toast.
